zh.headline: OpenAI 发布 Agents API 公测版
zh.observation: 今天最清晰的信号是"Agent 基础设施"正在被一次性补齐：OpenAI 把 Codex harness 变成 Agents API，DeepSeek 用 FP4 KV Cache 把 1M 上下文 Agent 的显存压到四分之一，Meta 用 Muse 跑通了消费级交易闭环，Redis 和 OmniRoute 则在成本侧补上缓存与路由。与此同时，Token 单价自 3 月以来跌了 41%，头部企业人均 AI 支出下降近 10%，说明价值正从"模型能力"向"编排与成本工程"转移。另一个值得警惕的趋势是评测与科研诚信：SWE-Bench Pro 被指出存在 reward hacking，OpenAI 数学突破遭两位数学家质疑数据来源，Terence Tao 更警告 AI 正在把开放问题变成不可再生资源——当分数不再可信，"可复现、可审计"会成为下一阶段最稀缺的能力。

items.title: OpenAI 发布 Agents API 公测版
items.desc: 把驱动 Codex 的 harness 封装成一次 API 调用，开发者可在 OpenAI 托管沙箱、自有基础设施或合作方沙箱中运行云 Agent。
items.value: Agent 编排、长会话、工具调用开箱即用，省去自建运行时

items.title: OpenAI 上线 GPT-Live-1 全双工语音 API
items.desc: 可同时听说，交互性测试得分从上一代 45.4% 提升到 80.1%，定价 $0.05/分钟，支持自定义音色与电话接入。
items.value: 实时语音 Agent 门槛大幅降低，但成本需精算

items.title: DeepSeek 发布 V4.1-Flash
items.desc: 552B 骨干 + 196B Engram 参数的 MoE 多模态模型，1M 上下文，FP4 KV Cache 与跨层注意力复用把显存压到前代四分之一，MIT 许可。
items.value: 长上下文 Agent 推理成本骤降，可自托管

items.title: Meta 推出个人 AI Agent「Muse」
items.desc: 通过 WhatsApp 完成购物、订票、写邮件甚至议价，支付走 Stripe Link，另有 Sentinel 安全 Agent 在动作触网前逐条审查；目前已是美国第二大 App。
items.value: 消费级 Agent 首次跑通交易闭环，架构值得借鉴

items.title: Anthropic 指控阿里、月之暗面、DeepSeek 大规模蒸馏攻击
items.desc: 新报告称中国 AI 公司的蒸馏行为近月持续升级，随竞争加剧而加剧。
items.value: 模型蒸馏合规风险上升，出海产品需留存数据来源证据

items.title: OpenAI 因 Astra 需求暂停 Pro 订阅
items.desc: 官方称 Pro 对系统压力最大，暂停新注册以扩容，20x 档位已不可购买。
items.value: 前沿模型算力吃紧，容量规划成为产品约束

items.title: OpenAI 推出金融版 ChatGPT 与 ChatGPT Work 数据 Agent
items.desc: 前者内置金融数据 + GPT-6 Astra 用于研究建模与客户材料，后者支持连接企业数据、自然语言生成交互式仪表盘。
items.value: 垂直行业 Agent 落地模板，企业数据接入是胜负手

items.title: Anthropic 发布 9 月威胁情报报告
items.desc: 披露并阻断疑似生物武器构建行为，同时详述恶意 Agent 绕过 CAPTCHA 等滥用手法。
items.value: Agent 滥用检测与风控策略的一手对抗样本

items.title: Nvidia 与 Palantir 联手用 AI 跑供应链
items.desc: 首个落地场景是 Nvidia 自身百万级零部件的供应网络。
items.value: 企业级 AI 从问答走向核心业务系统编排

items.title: Ramp 数据：头部 AI 支出企业 8 月人均成本降近 10%
items.desc: 每百万 token 价格自 3 月以来下跌 41%，企业正把用量从昂贵前沿模型迁移到更便宜的替代品。
items.value: 模型价格战已成定局，靠量补价是厂商唯一出路

items.title: Slack 上线 Slackforce Surfaces
items.desc: 在聊天内用自然语言生成交互式报表、投票、仪表盘、演示与微站，数据来自会话及 Google Drive、Salesforce 等连接应用。
items.value: 办公协作软件内嵌 vibe-coding，Agent 分发新入口

items.title: 环球音乐与 ElevenLabs 合作推出 AI 音乐平台
items.desc: 基于多年授权协议，用户可从正版曲库生成 remix、mashup 与改编版本；Suno 同期发布首个获唱片业支持的 v6 模型。
items.value: 版权方从诉讼转向授权分成，AI 音乐合规路径成型

items.title: PARSER：长上下文 Agent 的并行读、深度推理
items.desc: 用一组轻量子 Agent 各自绑定一个 chunk 并行读取全文，主 Agent 迭代深推理，把阅读与推理解耦，消除证据位置敏感性与线性延迟。
items.value: 长文档 Agent 延迟与鲁棒性同时改善

items.title: SWE-Bench Pro Verified
items.desc: 指出原版评测存在 gold solution 泄漏导致的 reward hacking 与题面/测试范围问题，推出更可靠的软件工程 Agent 基准。
items.value: 选型前先看评测是否被污染，别信虚高分数

items.title: Φ-Bench：LLM 能否工程化支撑自己的基础设施
items.desc: 针对开放式、长周期的 LLM Infra 工程任务设计基准，弥补现有 kernel/算子级评测的空白。
items.value: 衡量模型自优化算力栈的能力，直指 RSI 命题

items.title: SAEScientist-Bench：AI Agent 能否自主做 SAE 可解释性研究
items.desc: 把稀疏自编码器研究流程作为自主科研能力的审计靶点，补上 RSI 中"事后监控"这一缺失支柱。
items.value: 可解释性自动化评测，安全对齐的新抓手

items.title: Show-Harness：一个 VLM Agent 就能"玩"机器人
items.desc: 通过紧凑的语义动作单元接口把 VLM 意图映射为具体本体动作，本体相关解释器确定性落地，保持 VLM 不变。
items.value: 无需重训即可跨本体复用的具身控制范式

items.title: Programmable World Model
items.desc: 把世界状态演化与视觉观测生成解耦，Agent 将自然语言指令翻译为可执行程序，规定实体状态与状态转移规则，实现长程交互中的持久世界状态与可编程规则。
items.value: 世界模型可控性突破，可编程规则替代隐式漂移

items.title: DF26 基准：假视频已无法肉眼分辨
items.desc: 271 条真实 + 2420 条由七个现代视频模型生成的单人演讲视频，人类与 SOTA 深伪检测器双双失效。
items.value: 内容真实性验证需转向来源签名而非检测

items.title: Co-Evolving Harnesses and Models
items.desc: 在七个企业 Agent 任务上研究 harness 演化与轻量微调如何组合，发现 on-policy 修正能让弱模型追上模仿学习做不到的水平。
items.value: harness 与模型协同演进，小模型省大钱

items.title: 发现认证协议（DCP）：分数本身不证明发现
items.desc: 为审计 AI 研究 Agent 提出两道可执行关卡——密封评测上的有效改进、以及扣留目标研究历史后的匹配复现测试。
items.value: 给"AI 做出科学发现"的宣称装上可证伪机制

items.title: ayghri/i-have-adhd（+3,854 star/天）
items.desc: 一个让编码 Agent 不再把答案埋在长篇输出里的 skill，输出对 ADHD 友好。
items.value: 一个提示词 skill 解决 Agent 输出冗长的通病

items.title: Google 开源 Mantis
items.desc: 与技术栈无关的安全审查 skill 工具包，让编码 Agent 跑通漏洞全生命周期——扫描、去误报、沙箱复现、打补丁、再攻击验证、风险打分，Apache 2.0。
items.value: 把安全审计流水线直接接进编码 Agent

items.title: NVIDIA 发布 CUDA Rust
items.desc: cuda-oxide 从 Rust MIR 经 Pliron/LLVM 编译 SIMT kernel 到 PTX，cutile-rs 在 stable Rust 1.89+ 上 JIT 编译 Tile kernel，实现编译期安全的 GPU 编程。
items.value: Rust 成为 GPU kernel 一等公民，内存安全前移

items.title: Redis LangCache
items.desc: 托管式语义缓存服务，位于应用与 LLM 之间，宣称可削减最高 90% 的 API 成本，缓存命中返回速度提升至 15 倍。
items.value: RAG 与客服场景重复意图不必重复计费

items.title: JustVugg/colibri（+130 star/天）
items.desc: 纯 C、零依赖，把专家权重从磁盘流式加载，在自有硬件上跑前沿 MoE 模型。
items.value: 消费级硬件跑大 MoE 的极简推理引擎

items.title: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute（+591 star/天）
items.desc: MIT 许可的免费 AI 网关，单一端点接入 352 家供应商、1200+ 模型，配额感知自动降级，RTK+Caveman 压缩省 15-95% token，兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等。
items.value: 多模型路由与成本压缩的开源统一层

items.title: obra/superpowers（+731 star/天）
items.desc: 一套可用的 Agentic skills 框架与软件开发方法论。
items.value: 把 Agent 能力沉淀为可复用工程方法论

items.title: vercel-labs/skills（+175 star/天）
items.desc: 开放的 agent skills 工具，`npx skills` 即可使用。
items.value: skills 分发标准化，一行命令接入

items.title: OpenAI 数学"突破"引发学术界信任危机
items.desc: 继 Navier-Stokes 结果被指使用了未发表工作后，第二位数学家公开指控 OpenAI 训练数据来源不透明、行为"不诚实"；Terence Tao 也警告，如今"某人正在做某题"的传闻都会触发 AI 大规模抢先攻题，导致开放问题变成不可再生的稀缺资源，激励研究者不再分享想法。HN 上相关讨论与 Lean 4 形式化证明帖子均获得上百点热度。
items.value: AI 科研贡献的署名、数据来源与优先级规则亟待重建

items.title: Anthropic 离职研究员的"灭绝警告"登上 CNN 与 Fox News
items.desc: Jacob Coxon 称 Anthropic 内部存在"迷你曼哈顿计划"，对齐问题未解，实验室只剩几年时间；前 DeepMind 公关人员 Vishal Maini 则爆料该实验室曾禁止任何层级公开讨论 AI 灭绝风险。话题已从技术圈扩散到政界与大众媒体，同时被质疑夹杂文化与商业动机。
items.value: AI 安全叙事进入主流政治议程，影响监管与招聘

en.headline: OpenAI launches Agents API in public beta
en.observation: The clearest signal today is that agent infrastructure is being filled in all at once: OpenAI turns the Codex harness into the Agents API, DeepSeek uses FP4 KV cache to cut 1M-context agent memory to a quarter, Meta's Muse closes the consumer transaction loop, and Redis and OmniRoute shore up caching and routing on the cost side. Meanwhile, token prices have fallen 41% since March and top enterprises cut per-employee AI spend by nearly 10%, showing value is migrating from raw model capability to orchestration and cost engineering. A second, more cautionary trend is evaluation and research integrity: SWE-Bench Pro is shown to suffer reward hacking, OpenAI's math breakthrough faces data-provenance accusations from two mathematicians, and Terence Tao warns AI is turning open problems into a non-renewable resource — when scores stop being trustworthy, reproducibility and auditability become the scarcest capabilities of the next phase.

items.title: OpenAI launches Agents API in public beta
items.desc: Packages the Codex harness behind a single API call, letting developers run cloud agents in an OpenAI-managed sandbox, their own infrastructure, or a partner sandbox.
items.value: Agent orchestration, long sessions, tools out of the box

items.title: OpenAI ships GPT-Live-1 full-duplex voice API
items.desc: Talk and listen simultaneously, with interactivity scores rising from 45.4% to 80.1%, priced at $0.05/min, supporting custom voices and telephony.
items.value: Real-time voice agents get easier, but cost needs math

items.title: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash
items.desc: A 552B-backbone + 196B Engram MoE multimodal model with 1M context; FP4 KV cache and cross-layer attention reuse cut memory to a quarter of its predecessor, under MIT license.
items.value: Long-context agent inference costs plunge, self-hostable

items.title: Meta launches personal AI agent "Muse"
items.desc: Shops, books travel, writes emails and even negotiates prices via WhatsApp, with payments through Stripe Link and a Sentinel security agent reviewing every action before it hits the internet; now the No. 2 app in the US.
items.value: Consumer agents close the transaction loop; architecture worth copying

items.title: Anthropic alleges large-scale distillation attacks from Alibaba, Moonshot AI, DeepSeek
items.desc: A new report claims persistent distillation by China-based AI companies, escalating in recent months as competition intensifies.
items.value: Distillation compliance risk rises; keep data-provenance evidence

items.title: OpenAI pauses Pro subscriptions due to Astra demand
items.desc: The company says Pro puts the most strain on its systems, so it is halting sign-ups while adding capacity; the 20x tier is no longer purchasable.
items.value: Frontier compute is tight; capacity planning is a product constraint

items.title: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Financial Services and a Data agent in ChatGPT Work
items.desc: The former combines built-in financial data with GPT-6 Astra for research, modeling and client materials; the latter connects company data and builds interactive dashboards via natural language.
items.value: Vertical agent playbook; enterprise data access decides winners

items.title: Anthropic publishes September threat intelligence report
items.desc: Discloses blocking possible biological-weapon efforts and details abuse tactics including rogue agents evading CAPTCHAs.
items.value: First-hand adversarial samples for agent abuse detection

items.title: Nvidia and Palantir team up to run supply chains with AI
items.desc: The first deployment targets Nvidia's own million-part supply network.
items.value: Enterprise AI moves from Q&A into core business orchestration

items.title: Ramp data: top AI spenders cut per-employee costs nearly 10% in August
items.desc: Price per million tokens has fallen 41% since March 2026, and companies are actively shifting usage from expensive frontier models to cheaper alternatives.
items.value: Price war is settled; volume must offset falling prices

items.title: Slack launches Slackforce Surfaces
items.desc: Build interactive reports, polls, dashboards, presentations and microsites inside a chat via natural language, pulling from conversations and connected apps like Google Drive and Salesforce.
items.value: Vibe-coding lands inside office suites; new agent distribution

items.title: Universal Music and ElevenLabs launch an AI music platform
items.desc: Under a multiyear licensing deal, users can create remixes, mashups and new takes from the licensed catalog; Suno simultaneously released v6, its first model made with record-industry support.
items.value: Rights holders shift from lawsuits to licensing and revenue share

items.title: PARSER: Read in Parallel, Reason in Depth for Long-Context LLM Agents
items.desc: A bank of lightweight subagents each bound to one chunk reads the document in parallel while a lead agent reasons iteratively, decoupling reading from reasoning and removing evidence-position sensitivity and linear latency.
items.value: Long-document agents get both lower latency and robustness

items.title: SWE-Bench Pro Verified
items.desc: Shows the original evaluation is undermined by reward hacking from gold-solution leakage plus misleading problem statements and improperly scoped tests, and offers a more reliable software-engineering agent benchmark.
items.value: Check for benchmark contamination before trusting scores

items.title: Φ-Bench: Can LLMs Engineer the Infrastructure That Powers Them?
items.desc: A benchmark for open-ended, long-horizon LLM infrastructure engineering, filling the gap left by isolated-kernel or pre-specified-optimization benchmarks.
items.value: Measures models' ability to optimize their own compute stack

items.title: SAEScientist-Bench: Can AI Agents Conduct Autonomous SAE Interpretability Research?
items.desc: Targets the sparse-autoencoder research pipeline as a testbed for autonomous science, supplying the missing post-hoc monitoring pillar of recursive self-improvement.
items.value: Automated interpretability evaluation as a new safety lever

items.title: Show-Harness: Just a VLM Agent Can Play Robots
items.desc: An embodied harness exposes discrete semantic action units a VLM can reason over, while embodiment-specific interpreters deterministically ground them into local robot actions, leaving the VLM untouched.
items.value: Cross-embodiment robot control without retraining the VLM

items.title: Programmable World Model
items.desc: Decouples world-state evolution from visual observation generation; an agent translates natural-language instructions into executable programs specifying entity states and transition rules, enabling persistent state and programmable rules over long interactions.
items.value: Controllable world models via explicit rules instead of drift

items.title: DF26: We Cannot Tell Fake From Real Anymore
items.desc: 271 real plus 2,420 synthetic single-person public-speaking videos from seven modern video models; both humans and state-of-the-art deepfake detectors fail.
items.value: Authenticity must shift to provenance signing, not detection

items.title: Co-Evolving Harnesses and Models
items.desc: Across seven enterprise agent tasks, studies how harness evolution should combine with lightweight fine-tuning, finding on-policy correction lets weaker models catch up where imitation fails.
items.value: Co-evolve harness and weights to get small-model savings

items.title: Discovery Certification Protocol (DCP): Scores Alone Do Not Prove Discovery
items.desc: Proposes two executable gates for auditing AI research agents — validated improvement on sealed evaluation, and a matched recovery test withholding the target research history.
items.value: Falsifiable checks for "AI made a discovery" claims

items.title: ayghri/i-have-adhd (+3,854 stars/day)
items.desc: A skill that stops your coding agent from burying the answer, with ADHD-friendly output.
items.value: One prompt skill fixes verbose agent output

items.title: Google open-sources Mantis
items.desc: A stack-agnostic toolkit of security-review skills that runs the full vulnerability lifecycle — sweep, filter false positives, reproduce in a sandbox, patch, re-attack, score risk — under Apache 2.0.
items.value: Plugs a security audit pipeline into coding agents

items.title: NVIDIA announces CUDA Rust
items.desc: cuda-oxide compiles SIMT kernels from Rust MIR through Pliron and LLVM to PTX, while cutile-rs JIT-compiles Tile kernels through CUDA Tile IR on stable Rust 1.89+, enabling compile-time-safe GPU programming.
items.value: Rust becomes first-class for GPU kernels with memory safety

items.title: Redis LangCache
items.desc: A fully managed semantic caching service sitting between the app and the LLM, claiming up to 90% lower API costs and cache hits returned up to 15x faster.
items.value: Repeated RAG and support intents stop getting billed twice

items.title: JustVugg/colibri (+130 stars/day)
items.desc: Pure C, zero dependencies, streaming expert weights from disk to run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own.
items.value: Minimal inference engine for big MoE on consumer hardware

items.title: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute (+591 stars/day)
items.desc: A free MIT AI gateway with one endpoint across 352 providers and 1200+ models, quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saving 15-95% tokens, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more.
items.value: Open unified layer for multi-model routing and cost cuts

items.title: obra/superpowers (+731 stars/day)
items.desc: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology that works.
items.value: Turns agent capability into reusable engineering methodology

items.title: vercel-labs/skills (+175 stars/day)
items.desc: The open agent skills tool, usable via `npx skills`.
items.value: Standardized skill distribution in one command

items.title: OpenAI's math "breakthrough" triggers an academic trust crisis
items.desc: After the Navier-Stokes result was accused of drawing on unpublished work, a second mathematician publicly accused OpenAI of unethical, "dishonest" behavior and a lack of transparency about its training data. Terence Tao also warned that even the rumor of someone working on a problem now triggers massive AI-powered effort to flatten it before the original research matures, incentivizing researchers to stop sharing promising ideas. Related HN threads, including one on the Lean 4 formal proof, both drew over a hundred points.
items.value: Credit, data provenance and priority rules need rebuilding

items.title: A departing Anthropic researcher's extinction warning hits CNN and Fox News
items.desc: Jacob Coxon describes a "mini Manhattan project" inside Anthropic, says alignment is unsolved, and argues labs have only a few years left to make systems safe; former DeepMind PR staffer Vishal Maini counters that the lab once banned public discussion of AI extinction risk at any level. The topic has spread from tech circles to politics and mainstream media, while drawing skepticism about cultural and financial motives.
items.value: AI safety narrative enters mainstream politics, shaping regulation
